cases.title: Migrating off Firebase to Postgres
cases.body: We switched to Supabase from Firebase because Firestore vendor lock-in made reporting painful and we needed real Postgres SQL plus self-hosting.

cases.title: CI database branching comparison
cases.body: Ended up choosing Neon over Supabase for our CI pipeline because instant database branching per PR is unbeatable, even if cold start latency occasionally bites.

cases.title: Unexpected Firestore billing spike
cases.body: Our biggest dealbreaker with Firebase was an unexpected $1,400 weekend bill shock from a Firestore read loop with no hard spending cap.

cases.title: Neon vs Supabase cold starts
cases.body: We went with Supabase over Neon because wake from idle latency caused timeouts on our customer checkout API.

cases.title: Local dev experience matters
cases.body: Our team picked Supabase instead of Firebase mainly because local development with Docker and Postgres migrations was so much cleaner.

cases.title: Choice between MED-EL and AB
cases.body: Had the choice between MED-EL and AB. AB had the bluetooth and AB offered remote programming. If I went with Med-el it would be a 7h drive one way.

cases.title: Tele-audiology tiebreaker
cases.body: We chose Advanced Bionics over MED-EL because tele-audiology saved us a 5 hours drive to the regional clinic every quarter.

cases.title: Warranty turnaround comparison
cases.body: We went with Cochlear over AB primarily because our local audiologist stocked spare parts and warranty replacement took 24 hours instead of a week.

cases.title: Remote fitting vs travel
cases.body: I picked Advanced Bionics instead of MED-EL because remote fitting eliminated the long drive to our clinic.

cases.title: Ditching Salesforce for Attio
cases.body: Our sales team migrated to Attio from Salesforce because SFDC enterprise tier seat pricing and painful setup were dealbreakers.

cases.title: HubSpot pricing cliff
cases.body: We switched to Attio from HubSpot after hitting a massive pricing cliff when we needed custom reporting and SSO.

cases.title: Moving off HubSpot
cases.body: We chose HubSpot over Salesforce for our 40-person team because Salesforce onboarding and documentation were way too slow.
